confound_analysis.test-typst-element-lint.sh: known-failures.txt explicitly documents this suite as deliberately EXCLUDED from the manifest because a prior seed run's redness traced to an uncommitted, concurrently in-flight working-tree change to agent-system/extensions/typst/scripts/typst-element-lint.sh, not a committed defect. git status at the start of this dispatch shows that exact file (agent-system/extensions/typst/scripts/typst-element-lint.sh) modified and uncommitted right now (37 insertions/6 deletions) -- almost certainly a concurrently-dispatched sibling task's in-flight edit, reproducing the identical confound known-failures.txt already warns about. Not touched, not fixed -- reported per the plan's Shared-tree caution mitigation and Stage 3.6 Observation Duty.
confound_analysis.test-four-tier-conflict.sh: NOT previously documented in known-failures.txt. Failure is case 6, a budget-bound timing assertion (elapsed_ms=2115 vs budget_ms=1000) inside a suite that is one of run-all.sh's five LOAD_SENSITIVE_BASENAMES (always scheduled serially before the parallel pool, specifically because of this kind of sensitivity). With 24 concurrent agent-matching processes and at least one other sibling task (task 165) actively dispatched and writing to shared state/lock files during this 14-minute run, file-lock contention from genuine ambient concurrent-session load is the most likely explanation -- CPU load average (1.5-2.0) does not capture this kind of contention. This failure occurred BEFORE any change to verify-deploy.sh's gate8 call site (sequential --jobs=1 default, unmodified), so it cannot be caused by this task's future --jobs change. Carried forward as a named item to re-check in Phase 4's comparison: if it disappears post-change, it was transient ambient-load noise; if it recurs identically, it is pre-existing and orthogonal to this task's own change, reportable but not a Phase-4 decision-gate blocker (the gate's purpose is to catch sets that DIFFER because of the --jobs change, not to establish a globally clean tree).

baseline_record.gate8_own_share_of_wall_time: Not independently separable from this run's stdout alone (gate8 announcement lacks its own start/end timestamp in --quiet findings mode); task description's prior measurement (~9m21s of ~11m03s, ~86%) is cited as the prior expectation. This run's total (14m1.512s) is materially above the ~11m03s prior expectation, itself likely attributable to the same ambient concurrent-session load discussed above rather than a tree/gate8 regression.
